concerns.text: FR-007 (maximum iteration limit per simulation run) is not covered by any task or verification step. No task asserts that simulations exceeding the limit are flagged as non‑converged.
SC-001 (power‑law fit R² ≥ 0.8 for at least two topology types) is not enforced. T012 only checks R² ≥ 0.8 per fit but does not verify the count of topologies meeting the threshold.

SC-003 (total wall‑clock time for the full simulation suite ≤ 5 h) has no implementing task or measurable verification. A timing benchmark task is needed to record total runtime and assert the 5‑hour limit.
